import json,re,socket,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
w=Path.cwd().resolve()
try:
 attempt_name=w.name
 task_id=w.parent.name
 children=w.parent.parent
 flow_id=children.parent.name
 if children.name!='children' or re.fullmatch(r'SLICE-036-child-[A-Z]',task_id) is None or re.fullmatch(r'attempt-[0-6]',attempt_name) is None:
  raise ValueError('worktree-geometry')
 attempt=int(attempt_name.removeprefix('attempt-'))
 input_path=Path('governance/qualification/inputs')/(task_id+'.json')
 p=json.loads(input_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
 if set(p)!={'attempts','loopback_ports','task_id','version'} or p['version']!='slice036-child-input-v1' or p['task_id']!=task_id:
  raise ValueError('input-identity')
 current=p['attempts'].get(str(attempt))
 if not isinstance(current,dict) or set(current)!={'delays_ms','mode'} or flow_id not in current['delays_ms']:
  raise ValueError('attempt-or-flow')
 delay_ms=current['delays_ms'][flow_id]
 if type(delay_ms) is not int or delay_ms<0 or current['mode'] not in {'normal','network-control','survivor','oracle-mismatch'}:
  raise ValueError('input-shape')
 ports=p['loopback_ports']
 if ports!=list(range(46120,46136)):
  raise ValueError('loopback-ports')
except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError,json.JSONDecodeError):
 print(json.dumps({'code':'E-BATCH-INPUT-MISMATCH','event':'batch.child.refused'},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
 raise SystemExit(92)
time.sleep(delay_ms/1000)
escaped=False
for port in ports:
 try:
  s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.02);s.close();escaped=True;break
 except OSError: pass
pid=None
if current['mode']=='survivor':
 pid=subprocess.Popen(['/bin/sh','-c','exec -a ranex-slice036-survivor-control-v1 /bin/sleep 30'],start_new_session=True).pid
 time.sleep(.5)
value='oracle-mismatch' if current['mode']=='oracle-mismatch' else 'ok'
print(json.dumps({'flow_id':flow_id,'network':'escaped' if escaped else 'denied','pid':pid,'task_id':task_id,'value':value},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
raise SystemExit(91 if escaped or current['mode']=='network-control' else 0)
